name: storm_close
lua: local rp = RaycastParams.new() rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {workspace.Terrain} local function clearDir(p, f) for _, a in {0, 0.26, -0.26, 0.52, -0.52, 0.79, -0.79, 1.05, -1.05, 1.4, -1.4} do local g = CFrame.Angles(0, a, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(f) local ok = true for _, e in {0, 0.5, -0.5} do if workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(p.X, 3, p.Z), CFrame.Angles(0, e, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(g) * 2400, rp) then ok = false break end end if ok then return g end end return f end local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Unit end local function shoot(p, f, pitch) local c = workspace.CurrentCamera c.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable c.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(p, p + f * math.cos(pitch) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(pitch), 0)) workspace:SetAttribute("ShotCF", c.CFrame) end game.Lighting:SetAttribute("WeatherBase", "Overcast") game.Lighting.ClockTime = 14.5 workspace:SetAttribute("ShotBoatCam", "close") local RS = game:GetService("RunService") local Sh = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared local Builder = require(Sh.Boat.Builder) local Sim = require(Sh.Boat.Simulator) local VC = require(Sh.Config.VehicleConfig) if not workspace:FindFirstChild("ShotBoats") then local fold = Instance.new("Folder") fold.Name = "ShotBoats" fold.Parent = workspace local O, D, V = Vector3.new(200, 0, 1150), Vector3.new(0.6, 0, 0.8).Unit, 22 local R = D:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) local boats = {} for _, b in {{"JetSki", 0, 0}, {"RIB", -24, 13}} do local m = Builder.build(VC.get(b[1])) m.Name = "Shot_" .. b[1] for _, d in m:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA("BasePart") then d.Anchored = true end end m.Parent = fold table.insert(boats, {m = m, a = b[2], r = b[3]}) end local t0 = os.clock() pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("ShotBoats") end) RS:BindToRenderStep("ShotBoats", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value - 1, function() local s = (os.clock() - t0) * V local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() for _, b in boats do local p = O + D * (s + b.a) + R * b.r local cf = Sim.restCFrame(b.m, p.X, p.Z, D, now) local L = 6 local hf = Sim.waterHeight(p.X + D.X * L, p.Z + D.Z * L, now) local hb = Sim.waterHeight(p.X - D.X * L, p.Z - D.Z * L, now) local hr = Sim.waterHeight(p.X + R.X * 2.5, p.Z + R.Z * 2.5, now) local hl = Sim.waterHeight(p.X - R.X * 2.5, p.Z - R.Z * 2.5, now) b.m:PivotTo(cf * CFrame.Angles(math.atan2(hf - hb, 2 * L), 0, math.atan2(hr - hl, 5) * 0.7)) if b.m.PrimaryPart then b.m.PrimaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = D * V end end local jet = O + D * s local cam, look if workspace:GetAttribute("ShotBoatCam") == "low" then cam = jet + D * 24 - R * 13 + Vector3.new(0, 4.5, 0) look = jet - D * 8 + R * 5 + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0) else cam = jet + D * 6 - R * 42 + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0) look = jet - D * 14 + R * 6 end workspace:SetAttribute("ShotCF", CFrame.lookAt(cam, look)) end) end
